Module.Responsibility: Technology parser, validator, detector, and generator
DevelopmentPlan DataFlows and GenerationOrder parser, validator, and generator

Dependencies.Depends: Function contract matching for DataFlow coverage

Module.Responsibility: MentalTest parser, runner, pass/fail report, and trace persistence before code generation
MCP handlers for GRACE artifact generation and validation tools
Verification checks for requirements, technology, DataFlows, GenerationOrder, and MentalTests
Review sections for artifact completeness and integrity risks
Status reporting for artifact coverage and generation progress
GRACE skill guidance that reads GenerationOrder and DataFlows before execution

DataFlow.Data: generate_requirements request with project description, domain, and detail level
DataFlow.Transformation: Validate request and write docs/requirements.xml through M-GRACE-REQUIREMENTS
DataFlow.ErrorHandling: Return structured JSON-RPC error details and keep existing requirements artifact unchanged on failure

DataFlow.Data: generate_technology request with project path, detect_existing, and compatibility_check flags
DataFlow.Transformation: Detect manifests, pin exact versions, and write docs/technology.xml through M-GRACE-TECHNOLOGY
DataFlow.ErrorHandling: Return structured JSON-RPC error details and keep existing technology artifact unchanged on failure

DataFlow.Data: Artifact validation result and module-local verification checks
DataFlow.Transformation: Read artifacts, run verification checks, and emit pass/fail check results
DataFlow.ErrorHandling: Verification returns failed checks with actionable details instead of mutating artifacts

DataFlow.Data: mental_test_run request with module_id, mental_test_id, and step_by_step mode
DataFlow.Transformation: Validate request and delegate to MentalTest runner
DataFlow.ErrorHandling: Return structured JSON-RPC error details without code generation when a mental test fails

DataFlow.Data: MentalTest target, scenario, expected steps, and edge cases
DataFlow.Transformation: Parse MentalTests, evaluate expected vs actual steps, and persist trace XML
DataFlow.ErrorHandling: Return failure report and block execution guidance when steps do not pass

Phase.name: Artifact Foundation
Phase.Description: Generate artifact parsers before dependent MCP, verification, review, and status flows

Module.Rationale: RequirementsAnalysis is the first artifact input to planning
Technology stack pins versions before code generation
DevelopmentPlan consumes requirements and technology context
MentalTests depend on DevelopmentPlan structure before execution guidance can gate code
MCP handlers depend on artifact generator modules
Verification checks depend on artifact validators
Review sections depend on artifact validators and verification model
Status aggregates DevelopmentPlan validation and generation progress
Execution guidance reads GenerationOrder and DataFlows after validation exists

MentalTest.Description: Pre-code simulation for running a mental test before implementation proceeds
MentalTest.Scenario: GIVEN: DevelopmentPlan contains MT-001 with expected and actual step traces WHEN: mental_test_run is called for M-GRACE-MENTAL-TEST and MT-001

Step.expected: MT-001 is extracted with target, steps, edge cases, result, and rationale
Step.actual: PASS — MT-001 is extracted with target, steps, edge cases, result, and rationale

Steps.Step: Parser reads only the MentalTests section and keeps DevelopmentPlan validation separate.

Step.expected: all PASS actual values satisfy expected outcomes
Step.actual: PASS — all PASS actual values satisfy expected outcomes

Steps.Step: Runner compares expected/actual step traces before code generation continues.

Step.actual: PASS — docs/mental-tests/MT-001.xml records the run result

Steps.Step: Trace persistence makes later implementation drift visible.

Case.description: A step actual starts with FAIL
Case.expectation: mental_test_run returns passed=false and verify blocks code generation

MentalTest.Rationale: The algorithm blocks on missing or failed simulations and records a trace before implementation work continues.

Pattern.name: ExplicitTyping
Pattern.Rule: All type conversions must use explicit cast/parse syntax.

Pattern.name: ExplicitFlow
Pattern.Rule: Business logic returns Result-like values instead of unwrap, panic, or broad exception paths.

Pattern.name: ExplicitNullHandling
Pattern.Rule: Nullable values must be resolved through explicit branches instead of long optional or null-coalescing chains.

Pattern.name: NoMagicValues
Pattern.Rule: Thresholds, durations, and long user-visible strings must be named constants or explicit artifacts.

Pattern.name: DeterministicIteration
Pattern.Rule: Hash-based collection iteration must be sorted before user-visible output.

Guideline.name: ErrorCoverage
Guideline.Rule: Every DataFlow error path must be documented in the target function contract.

Guideline.name: LogCoverage
Guideline.Rule: Every DataFlow transition point should have a structured LOG expectation.
